children.text: 1. Opening & Current Situation
Opening and Stating Problem
Boys and girls, Good morning! Today, I'd like to talk about protecting endangered animals.
children.cn: 同学们，早上好！今天我想谈谈保护濒危动物。
children.notes: 演讲开场白; I'd like to talk about: 我想谈谈
children.statement: 这句话用来引出当天的演讲主题。
children.explanation: 开篇点题，明确演讲目的。

children.text: As we know, many wild animals are in great danger of disappearing now.
children.cn: 众所周知，许多野生动物现在正面临着消失的巨大危险。
children.notes: As we know: 众所周知; in danger of: 处于……的危险中
children.statement: 这句话描述了当前濒危动物的严峻现状。
children.explanation: 对应思维导图中的 current situation: be in danger。

children.text: Their living areas are becoming smaller and smaller because of human activities.
children.cn: 由于人类活动，它们的生存区域正变得越来越小。
children.notes: smaller and smaller: 越来越小; because of: 因为，由于
children.statement: “because of” 后面通常接名词、代词或动名词。
children.explanation: because of 是介词短语，后接名词性短语 human activities。
children.keywords: living areas, smaller, because of, human activities

children.text: 2. Reasons for Protection
Why We Need to Protect
First, wild animals are our good friends and they make nature lively.
children.cn: 首先，野生动物是我们的好朋友，它们让大自然充满生机。
children.notes: good friends: 好朋友; lively: 充满生机的
children.statement: “lively” 是形容词，意为“充满生机的，活泼的”。
children.explanation: lively 是以 -ly 结尾的形容词，在句中作宾语补足语。
children.keywords: First, wild animals, good friends, lively

children.text: Second, protecting them is also protecting ourselves because we share the same planet.
children.cn: 其次，保护它们也就是保护我们自己，因为我们共享同一个星球。
children.notes: protecting ourselves: 保护我们自己; share the same planet: 共享同一个星球
children.statement: 句中的 “protecting” 是动名词作主语。
children.explanation: 动名词短语 protecting them 作从句主语，谓语动词用 is。

children.text: 3. Ways to Protect & Ending
Actions and Conclusion
To save these animals, we must stop cutting down forests and plant more trees.
children.cn: 为了拯救这些动物，我们必须停止砍伐森林并种植更多的树木。
children.notes: To save: 为了拯救（目的状语）; stop doing sth.: 停止做某事
children.statement: “stop cutting down” 表示停止砍伐的动作。
children.explanation: stop doing sth. 表示停止正在做的事，stop to do 表示停下来去做另一件事。
children.keywords: save, stop cutting down, forests, plant trees

children.text: In addition, we should never buy products made from rare wild animals.
children.cn: 此外，我们绝不应该购买由稀有野生动物制成的产品。
children.notes: In addition: 此外; made from: 由……制成
children.statement: “made from” 过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 products。
children.explanation: made from rare wild animals 作后置定语，修饰前面的名词 products。
children.keywords: In addition, never buy products, made from, rare animals

children.text: Let us take action together to build a safe home for all wildlife.
children.cn: 让我们共同采取行动，为所有野生动植物建造一个安全的家园。
children.notes: take action: 采取行动; build a safe home: 建造安全的家园
children.statement: “wildlife” 是不可数名词，表示“野生动植物”。
children.explanation: wildlife 是集合名词，通常不可数，指自然环境中的野生动植物。
children.keywords: take action, together, safe home, wildlife

children.text: Thank you.
children.statement: 演讲结束时的礼貌用语。

children.text: 1. Opening & Current Situation
Engaging Hook & Urgent Reality
Boys and girls, Good morning! Today, I'd like to talk about protecting endangered animals.
children.cn: 同学们，早上好！今天我想谈谈保护濒危动物。
children.statement: 开篇清晰交代演讲主题。
children.explanation: 标准演讲开头，直接切入主题。

children.text: At present, countless amazing species are in great danger of disappearing completely from the earth.
children.cn: 目前，无数神奇的物种正面临着从地球上完全消失的巨大危险。
children.notes: At present: 目前; countless: 无数的; disappear completely: 完全消失
children.statement: “in danger of disappearing” 中 disappearing 是动名词作介词 of 的宾语。
children.explanation: 介词 of 后面接动名词形式 disappearing。
children.keywords: At present, countless, amazing species, danger, disappearing

children.text: Human activities and rapid deforestation have severely threatened their survival environment.
children.cn: 人类活动和急剧的森林砍伐已经严重威胁到了它们的生存环境。
children.notes: deforestation: 森林砍伐; severely threatened: 严重威胁
children.statement: 句子使用了现在完成时（have threatened）表示对现在造成的影响。
children.explanation: have + 过去分词构成现在完成时态。
children.keywords: Human activities, deforestation, severely threatened, environment

children.text: 2. Reasons for Protection
Interconnection & Ecological Harmony
First of all, animals are our indispensable friends who maintain the ecological balance of nature.
children.cn: 首先，动物是我们不可或缺的朋友，它们维系着大自然的生态平衡。
children.notes: indispensable: 不可或缺的; maintain: 维持; ecological balance: 生态平衡
children.statement: “who maintain...” 是定语从句，修饰先行词 friends。
children.explanation: who 在定语从句中作主语，指代人或被拟人化的动物朋友。
children.keywords: First of all, indispensable friends, maintain, ecological balance

children.text: Not only are they our companions, but protecting them is also protecting ourselves, since all lives are interconnected.
children.cn: 它们不仅是我们的伙伴，而且保护它们就是保护我们自己，因为所有生命都是相互联系的。
children.notes: Not only... but... also...: 不仅……而且……; since: 因为，由于; interconnected: 互相联系的
children.statement: 句首 “Not only” 引起了部分倒装结构（are they）。
children.explanation: 否定词 Not only 置于句首时，主句采用部分倒装语序。
children.keywords: Not only, companions, but also, protect ourselves, since, interconnected

children.text: 3. Concrete Actions & Vision
Call to Action and Ending
Therefore, we must stop cutting down forests immediately and establish more natural reserves for them.
children.cn: 因此，我们必须立即停止砍伐森林，并为它们建立更多的自然保护区。
children.notes: establish: 建立; natural reserves: 自然保护区
children.explanation: natural reserves 是环保领域的常用专业表达。
children.keywords: Therefore, stop cutting down, forests, establish, natural reserves

children.text: If each of us makes a small effort, we can surely create a harmonious world for all living creatures.
children.cn: 如果我们每个人都付出一点微小的努力，就一定能为所有生物创造一个和谐的世界。
children.notes: make an effort: 付出努力; harmonious: 和谐的; living creatures: 生物
children.statement: “If” 引导条件状语从句，遵循主将从现原则。
children.explanation: 从句用一般现在时 makes，主句用情态动词 can create。
children.keywords: If, effort, harmonious world, living creatures

children.text: Thank you.
